reason: My ERP partner is the first call I make for anything touching purchasing data, and I don't want a second tool reading our POs and supplier mail from outside the system. A free six-week test I might agree to look at, but I would not sign a $2,000 a month pilot on the strength of a deck and a demo.
objection: It works from exports and forwarded emails, not from the ERP. If the data is stale or incomplete, the ranked list could send my team after the wrong exceptions, and I would be the one explaining it to the plant manager.
would_change_my_mind: A six-week test that catches a late supplier date or a short ship before it hits a work order, with the premium freight or line-down cost it prevented written down in dollars.
